messages:
ana (PM): quick thread  need a short SLA appendix we can attach: credits, escrow steps, evidence artifacts. can we land numbers?

mike (Eng-Sec): propose automated KMS failover SLO = 15m (target), manual escrow path = 4h+ ops approval. export SLA: validated export delivered within 72h standard, 24h priority lane (if paid).

sasha (Legal): credits only. tiered table idea: minor (SLO miss but <4h) = 0.5% MRR, major (>=4h) = 1% MRR, critical (>=24h) = 2% MRR. caps: 10% per incident, 50% annual. carve-outs: legal hold, customer key compromise, 3rd party KMS outage.

devin (AE): customers will push shorter windows; offer priority lane as purchasable add-on. they also want export manifest sample in appendix.

tina (CS): auditors expect: manifest with export_id, tenant, timestamp, object list, sha256, signed_by, operator id. need runbook to produce within 5 business days.

opsbot: Note: export-worker-v2 deployed us-east-1 at 2025-10-01T12:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

mike (Eng-Sec): paste sample manifest (example): {"export_id":"exp-2469123456-001","tenant":"finco-app","created_at":"2025-10-01T11:58:00Z","objects":["s3://rwd-e/finco/part-000.gz"],"sha256":"ab12...","signed_by":"redwood-op-7","chain_of_custody":["requested_by:client@finco.com","approved_by:ops@redwood.com"]}

sasha (Legal): I'll draft appendix language and table by Thu. include escalation to execs for exceptions.

ana (ana (PM)): actions: 1) eng estimate failover testing + manifest tooling (1w) 2) product/legal: finalize credit table (this week) 3) cs: collect 3 customer asks (EOD) 4) sec/ops: ops cost for escrow path. sync Fri AM. :thumbsup:
